description: This file defines the SugarLoggerHandler class which integrates Monolog logging with the LoggerManager in the SuiteCRM project. It includes methods for writing log records and converting log levels.

classes.name: SugarLoggerHandler
classes.description: A class that extends Monolog's AbstractProcessingHandler to route logs through SuiteCRM's LoggerManager.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Handles writing a log record to the LoggerManager, converting the log level and formatting the message.

methods.name: psrToSugarLevel
methods.description: Converts Monolog PSR log levels to SuiteCRM LoggerManager log level strings.
